d: Long, straight sage-green hair with blunt bangs and two long strands framing the face flows down the back, paired with narrow, sleepy-looking deep purple eyes. The face appears as a mature young adult with a slender, lean build. The outfit consists of a black sleeveless mini-dress with white criss-cross detailing on the chest, worn under a long, oversized white and dark teal coat that hangs off the shoulders, and finished with black pointed high heels. Signature details include large rounded animal ears atop the head, a long thin tail, and black-rimmed goggles with iridescent lenses perched on the forehead.
